### Models
- **Transaction Risk Model** — Predicts fraud probability (0–100)
- **Anomaly Detection Model** — Detects unusual patterns
- **Chargeback Prediction** — Predicts dispute likelihood
name: Chunk 30/57

raw_entities.name: Transaction Risk Model
raw_entities.description: A predictive model that scores transaction fraud probability on a 0–100 scale. Used to identify and flag potentially fraudulent transactions for investigation and response.
context: Transaction Risk Model — Predicts fraud probability (0–100)

raw_entities.name: Anomaly Detection Model
raw_entities.description: A detection model that identifies unusual patterns in customer account activity. Supports fraud prevention by flagging transactions that deviate from established customer behaviour.
context: Anomaly Detection Model — Detects unusual patterns

raw_entities.name: Chargeback Prediction Model
raw_entities.description: A predictive model that estimates the likelihood of a transaction resulting in a customer dispute or chargeback. Enables proactive identification of high-risk transactions.
